core_obligations: Identify the module: the zeroth local cohomology of the completion is the kernel of the map from the completion to the product of the localised completions, which for a finite module is the kernel of the corresponding map from the module itself (proof lines 2380-2387)

Local vanishing: the kernel of a localisation into its completion is the intersection of the powers of the ideal, which vanishes locally on the locus cut out by the ideal by the standard statement (proof lines 2388-2393)

Support argument: for an element of that kernel the support meets the locus only inside a prescribed closed subset, so the element lies in a local cohomology of a subideal, and conversely such elements die in the localised completions (proof lines 2394-2404)
proof_roadmap: M 有限 ⇒ I-进完备；由 lemma-completion-local 的证明得 H^0(RΓ_Z(M)^∧) = Ker(M^∧ → ∏M_{g_j}^∧) = Ker(M → ∏M_{g_j}^∧)。
各核 K_j = ∩ I^n M_{g_j}；由「幂交局部消失」的代数引理，对 V(IA_{g_j}) 中每点可取 f 使 (K_j)_f = 0。
取 s 属于该核，把 s 看作 M 的元素；其支集 Z' 与 D(g_j) ∩ V(I) 不交 ⇒ Z' ∩ V(I) ⊂ V(J) ⇒ 存在 J' ⊂ J 使 Z' ∪ V(J) = V(J') 且 V(J') ∩ V(I) ⊂ V(J)，故 s ∈ H^0_{V(J')}(M)；反之这类元素在 M_{g_j}^∧ 中为零。
